messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: throttle_spike detected in eu-west-1 - tokens_per_sec 2.8x baseline, throttle_events 14m over last 5m, queue_depth median 420 -> paging the on-call rota :rotating_light:

sre-oncall: I'm on it. grabbing logs and linking traces. Maria, can you confirm customer-facing impact?

dev-maria: seeing elevated tail latency on generation endpoints, ~800ms -> some timeouts in the dashboard. A few customer sessions retried, but no full 5xx surge yet.

infra-devon: autoscaler scaling events look muted - controllers show target_utilization hitting cap but new nodes not provisioned (pending spot allocation).

prod-eng-jake: adding context: we rolled a minor qprof change in the serving runtime 3 hours ago, but nothing on the autoscaler config. worth checking routing fallbacks.

ops-runner: Note: a previous mitigant was an emergency fallback to smaller model variant. Can flip it per-route. Do we want to try that now while we investigate autoscale? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sre-oncall: yes — fallback to rwd-small for non-legal customers for next 15m. dev-maria, can you patch that route?

dev-maria: will do. applying route change: 
```
# apply fallback routing for non-enterprise
redwoodctl routes patch --route /v1/generate --match tier!=enterprise --fallback rwd-small --reason "throttle surge mitigation"
```

eng-mel: FYI I slapped a temporary alert to suppress pager noise while we stabilize: `alert: throttle_spike (debounce 3m -> 5m, severity -> warning)` so tier-1 pages don't flood.

infra-devon: scaled dedicated pool `eu-west-1-dedicated-pool` +4 GPUs manually via infra-api (hot-add). Command: `infractl capacity increase --pool eu-west-1-dedicated-pool --gpus 4 --reason "live mitigation"` — provisioning in progress (ETA ~6m).

incident-bot: NOTE: plan change recorded in incident timeline.

prod-eng-jake: after fallback and hot-add, throttle_events dropped to 40% of peak. tokens/sec trending down. Great. Any continued customer errors?

dev-maria: a handful of retries but error rate back near baseline. Marking customer-impact as partial degradation -> low.

ops-runner: opened a short-lived support banner for affected customers in eu-west-1 to be transparent.

sre-oncall: good. I'll keep watch for autoscaler failures. Devon can you dig into why the autoscaler didn't spin up nodes automatically? Might be spot allocation or capacity constraints.

infra-devon: digging. Initial look: cloud provider returned delayed capacity due to recent AZ reclamation; autoscaler retried but hit allocation backoff. We'll file a root cause but for now planning to add a fallback node type (on-demand) to the autoscaler policy to prevent total stall.

eng-mel: For follow-up: propose two alert tuning changes: 1) add a tokens/sec lead indicator with 2-min slope check to warn before queue_depth jumps, 2) increase queue_depth debounce to 4m for autoscale paging to reduce noise from transient spikes.

sre-oncall: agreed. Also want a small dashboard tile: tokens/sec per model variant + autoscaler pending_count vs provisioned_count. Mel, can you own the dashboard?

eng-mel: taking it. I'll create a Grafana panel and a runbook snippet: "tokens/sec -> if slope > 2x in 2m AND queue_depth > 250 for 3m -> page oncall" (but with a 4m debounce for actual pages).

prod-eng-jake: add a model fallback policy to the router config so that non-critical traffic can auto-fall back when a variant reports >5% throttles in 2m. That reduces full-capacity pressure.

dev-maria: created a follow-up ticket: INF-4392 "Autoscaler backoff + fallback node type" and INF-4393 "Alert tuning + tokens/sec dashboard". Assigning to infra-devon and eng-mel respectively.

infra-devon: I'll investigate cloud allocation logs and update INF-4392 with mitigation plan (on-demand fallback + better metrics for pending pods).

ops-runner: ops banner removed — stability restored in eu-west-1 for >10m.

sre-oncall: summary for handoff: incident resolved -> partial customer degradation for ~18m, mitigations: route-level fallback applied, +4 GPUs hot-add, temporary alert debounce increased, autoscaler investigation ongoing. No escalation required.

prod-eng-jake: QA: please capture latency percentile before/after in the postmortem so product can correlate.

eng-mel: will capture p50/p95/p99 and include the new dashboard links in the postmortem.

sre-oncall: handing off to next oncall (dev-maria). key todos: monitor INF-4392/4393, validate autoscaler on-demand fallback, and verify dashboard alerts in canary. Logging handoff at 2178001405. :white_check_mark:
